id.description: Unique, permanent id: lowercase letters, digits and '-', in dot-separated parts. Prefer a domain you own, reversed: "com.example.books".

api.description: The plugin API the plugin is written for.

main.description: The main module, a .js, .mjs, .ts or .mts file relative to plugin.json. Default main.js.

icon.description: The plugin's icon, from Dalibre's set.

capabilities.description: What the plugin adds to Dalibre.

bookSource.description: A catalogue in Dalibre's Get books page. Export search; with collections, also collections and list.

collections.description: Lists to browse while the search box is empty.

title.description: Required for select; a language's name is Dalibre's.

metadata.description: Looks up books' details for Fetch metadata in Edit metadata. Export identify; needs permissions.library "read".

fields.description: The fields the source can fill, shown to the user.

fileType.description: Works on books' files: each file Dalibre adds, and the books the user runs it on from the book menu. Export process.

title.description: What running it is called in the book menu, as "Clean up EPUB". Default: the plugin's name.

onImport.description: false to run only from the book menu, not on the files Dalibre adds. Default true.

onPostImport.description: Call postimport after a file was added to a book, as calibre's on_postimport. Needs permissions.library.

onPostAdd.description: Call postadd after a book was added, as calibre's on_postadd. Needs permissions.library.

onPostDelete.description: Call postdelete after a format was removed, as calibre's on_postdelete. Needs permissions.library.

hosts.description: Every host the plugin fetches or downloads from, redirects included. "*.example.com" matches subdomains.

localNetwork.description: Reach this computer and the local network, as a home OPDS server. Users are warned.

library.description: "read": see the details of the books the plugin is asked about; metadata sources and file type hooks need it. "write": also lets file type hooks change those details.
